spans.text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.

reasoning: This card's own single `custom` effect implements exactly this: `actions.chooseTarget(ctx.you.getCreaturesInPlay())` picks the boosted creature, `actions.putCounter(boosted, '+1/+1', 1)` is the exact counter, and `actions.dealDamage(boosted, victim, boosted.getNetPower())` (after re-choosing the opponent's creature target) is the exact "deals damage equal to its power" clause — one shared local `boosted` variable ties both sentences to the SAME creature, same convention any single-custom-effect two-clause card in this pool uses when a later clause must reference an earlier target.
